name: ne-cash-payment-tax
description: Niger 2026 cash-payment tax working paper for ordinary buyer-chosen cash payments to an enterprise under a real taxation regime, using the rules from 21 August 2026. Use this Guide to screen the payment threshold, separate VAT from the calculation base, identify who bears and invoices the levy, prepare monthly totals and retain evidence. It distinguishes the special supplier-requested cash withholding branch, which is referred for further calculation work. It does not provide a VAT return, a full portal walkthrough or an early-2026 liability conclusion. Two executable examples test the ordinary calculation and threshold decision. No accountant has attested to this draft.
